name: Yerevan
summary: Yerevan is one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, built from rosy tuff stone with Mount Ararat on the horizon. Climb the Cascade for the view, learn about the genocide at Tsitsernakaberd, browse the Vernissage market and day-trip to Garni temple, Geghard monastery and Khor Virap.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are perfect; summer is very hot.
arrival: Zvartnots Airport is 20 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Walk; Yandex Go and GG taxis are cheap.
cashTip: Prices are shown in US dollars; locally you pay in Armenian dram (AMD), about 390 to the dollar. Cards work in Yerevan; carry dram for taxis, markets and day trips.
buyTip: Armenian brandy and carpets at Vernissage.

connections.note: Marshrutkas and shared taxis; overnight train in summer.
